segments.transcript: He didn't allow us to call him Daddy. And I wanted to call him Daddy so bad. He said, I'm not Daddy. I'm Joseph to you.
[Oprah: And were you scared of him?] Very frightened. There's been times when he'd come to see me and I would get sick. [Oprah: Really?] I'd start to regurgitate.
[Bashir: Would he only use a belt?]
[Bashir: What else would he use to hit you with?]
Throw you up against the wall as hard as you could.
I just remember hearing my mother scream, Joe, you're gonna kill him, you're gonna kill him, stop it, you're gonna kill him.
[Walters: Do you like being a father?] I love it.
[Host: (But) what was he like as a dad?] Awesome. Really fun to just spend time with.
I'm very particular about how I tie my tie, because my dad taught me how to tie my tie.
that's a piece of him that I bring with me anytime I try to show up and represent for him.
[Alex Cooper: how would you have described your dad?]
Really funny guy. That was my best friend.
